Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the top non-background pattern into the zero rectangle, horizontally flipped."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = g[0][0]
    # Find the non-background pattern's bounding box in the top section.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and v != 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    pattern = [g[r][c0:c1 + 1] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    # The zero rectangle is the destination; fill it with the horizontal reflection.
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    dr0 = min(r for r, c in zeros)
    dr1 = max(r for r, c in zeros)
    dc0 = min(c for r, c in zeros)
    dc1 = max(c for r, c in zeros)
    flipped = [row[::-1] for row in pattern]
    for i, r in enumerate(range(dr0, dr1 + 1)):
        for j, c in enumerate(range(dc0, dc1 + 1)):

    return g
